Name: Goat Mount (Black Version) - Ride a goat
Author: powdercake
Description:
This simply replaces the horse sprite with the goat sprite, so the mount will still sound like a horse.
[u]
[/u][u]How to install[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Copy [font=Courier New]goatHorseBlack.xnb[/font] into the [font=Courier New]\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals[/font] folder.
[*]Rename the [font=Courier New]horse.xnb[/font] file to horse-backup.xnb
[*]Rename [font=Courier New]goatHorseBlack.xnb[/font] to [font=Courier New]horse.xnb[/font]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Replace your horse mount with a black goat.
